mode: Herramienta integrada image_gen; edición de fondo
note: Los ambientes neutros son ediciones digitales. Se revisaron puertas, cajones, tiradores, espejos y disposición general de listones. Las fotos originales se conservan para comparación. Los fondos no documentan instalaciones reales.

Asset type: real client furniture photograph for a carpentry portfolio website.
Input image 1 is the edit target, NOT loose design inspiration.
Primary request: professionally replace only the untidy surrounding background with a restrained warm off-white studio setting, pale stone floor and soft believable daylight. Photorealistic, simple, warm, no props or decorations, no text or watermarks. Preserve the actual furniture, its exact shape, perspective, proportions, panel seams, materials, color, edges and hardware; do not redesign or beautify its construction. Keep original portrait framing and camera angle. Subject: the TWO white dressing tables, one foreground left with its single drawer open toward the lower right, the other behind on the right with drawer closed. Each has its rectangular mirror and long horizontal light above. Preserve both tables, both lights (front lit, rear unlit), exact drawer positions, reflective white finish, mirror frames and visible side panels. Replace the workshop clutter visible in both mirror reflections with plausible reflections of the same empty neutral studio. Remove only loose packaging from the tabletop and workshop surroundings, ladders, scraps and cables that are not furniture. Keep all furniture geometry and the dark drawer runner unchanged. Do not add legs, handles, drawers, shelves or decorative accessories. Avoid synthetic CGI appearance.
